channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Ebola vaccine tested in DR Congo outbreak area
item.description: Health workers in parts of the Democratic Republic of Congo affected by a deadly Ebola outbreak began a test vaccination program on Saturday.

item.title: Pittsburgh kindergartners fall below measles safety threshold
item.description: Measles cases and exposure alerts in Pittsburgh have drawn attention, testing the city's vaccine legacy.

item.title: Physician reimbursement cuts meet AI audits
item.description: Physician reimbursement has faced sustained downward pressure for years, while insurers have expanded tools including AI-driven audits and prior authorization.

item.title: No single solution for malaria elimination, expert says
item.description: As malaria cases and deaths rise worldwide and resistance threatens current treatments and prevention tools, eliminating malaria will require a combination of approaches.
